property_summary: For any from, caddress, _tos array and v, if a call to transfer on the original contract does not revert, then calling transfer on a mutant that skips the last element must also not revert; but a non-empty _tos can be found where the original reverts because the last element fails while the mutant succeeds, breaking the implication.
If the original transfer reverts, then either the tos array is empty or the last element's external call causes the revert.
If transfer does not revert, then _tos must have length 1 or the last element's external call must succeed.

property_summary: The original contract always processes all elements of _tos, so if the original reverts, the modified version that skips the last element must also revert when _tos has length exactly 1; otherwise there exists an input where they differ.
For any input where both versions do not revert, the original must have called transferFrom on every address in _tos.
